text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that...!?
Yaeno Muteki... that finishing stretch of hers was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That run had serious power!
Wouldn't you say she's one to watch for next year's Classic circuit?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So this is the Twinkle Series...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: ...Yaeno? Are you all right?
...Yaeno? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Yaeno Muteki returned to the waiting room,
exhaustion was plainly written all over her face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't even breathing heavily
after the finish line, so what in the world happened?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I have no excuses. It seems I was
swallowed up by the atmosphere of the racetrack.
choice_data_list: Did you get overwhelmed by the atmosphere?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps I was swept up
by the sheer frenzy brought by the crowd...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I struggled more than usual
to control the flames within.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the crowd's excitement stirred up her competitive spirit, making her hard to control.
As a result, she must have ended up mentally exhausted.
choice_data_list: Go home and get some proper rest today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It would be best to prioritize your recovery for now.
I suggest we head straight home and hold a meeting tomorrow
instead of regular training."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I apologize for causing you trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next morning. Has Yaeno Muteki recovered?
With that in mind,
I head down to the riverbed for a walk.
Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was surprised, I also had a hunch.
Because the Yaeno Muteki I knew was strict with herself,
a truly stoic Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer-dono.
Good morning.
choice_data_list: Is everything all right with your condition?
Is your condition okay?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is amiss. The heaviness has lifted,
and my mind is clear and sharp.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Just like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging by how she's racking up reps in good rhythm,
she seems to be fine. But...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could sense a feeling of impatience from her. Because today,
she was doing actual training rather than just running through forms.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: Are you in a rush about something?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...What keen insight you have.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In yesterday's debut race...
I was made painfully aware of my own inexperience.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To let my composure be disturbed by the fervor of the crowd...
How truly fragile my spirit is.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in knowing I ran a race
I could be satisfied with yesterday.
However, when I think of the future...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is impossible to fight through to the end
while "Unity of Fire and Water" remains unstable.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I need further discipline of both mind and body!
choice_data_list: In that case, you could have just talked to me about it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, this is simply a flaw of my own nature. I cannot trouble you with it, Trainer-dono—
choice_data_list: I don't think it's any trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've already factored in the intensity of her fighting spirit.
I tell her that I'm also prepared to consult with Yaeno Muteki to plan her mental training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Are you out of your mind?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No, excuse me...
You're the first person who's ever said that to me...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: After all, I was so rowdy as a child that the adults, my teachers included, threw their hands up in despair...

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I held back like a good girl!
I was mad, but I stayed quiet and held it in!
B-But, he just wouldn't stop!"

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I kept getting more and more annoyed and frustrated, until my head just went red-hot...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so you managed to hold back.
Then try holding out a little longer next time.
Little by little is fine. Just extend that time of restraint.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, we must practice.
Come, Yaeno."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—Even when I struggled to follow his teachings,
my grandfather patiently stood by me.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And whenever I felt down,
my grandmother would gently stay by my side and support me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even I must admit,
it was quite the grueling endeavor.
choice_data_list: I want to face things together with you too.
I want to face you properly, too

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Why go so far?
choice_data_list: Because I'm your trainer.
Because I'm your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm carrying three precious years of Yaeno Muteki's life on my shoulders.
I plead with her, making it clear that I'm not taking things lightly
by thinking that merely winning is enough.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It appears that I was the one
underestimating your duties, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It seems you're fully prepared
to endure any hardship for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Then will you shoulder it alongside me?
All of this trouble that is me."
choice_data_list: That's the plan!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Your eyes are clear and unclouded.
This isn't out of mere courtesy—you truly mean it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you once again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I intend to do my utmost in my own way
so as not to fall short of your sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I would not wish to burden you with as much worry as my grandparents, Trainer-dono.
choice_data_list: You're truly grateful to those old folks, aren't you?
You're truly grateful to those old folks, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so.
That is why I want to show my grandparents how much I've grown through this Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It might not be much of a repayment, but...
please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And the only way to prove my growth
is to defeat the strong without letting my fighting spirit run wild.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I hope to fight against
many strong opponents in the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: Then, our next goal is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My ambition lies on the Classic Triple Crown path.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's the royal road, there's no doubt the strongest will gather.
And by competing with them, I want to hone and elevate both my mind and body."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If there is just one concern, however……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown races are a massive stage
I've never experienced before.
I feel a little uneasy about whether I can maintain my own running...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, the excitement of the Classic Triple Crown
is on a completely different level compared to a debut race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems necessary to hone her racing instincts
so she can get used to the racecourse atmosphere
and run her own race. In that case—
choice_data_list: How about entering the Mainichi Hai?
Wanna enter the Mainichi Hai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain that given the caliber of the participating field,
it would serve as an ideal prep race looking ahead to the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it will also give us time to make adjustments
in case any issues come up... I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's go with the Mainichi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, now that our goal is set,
I'm even more fired up!
